entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system to reduce token consumption. This AGPL-3.0 context database provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and achieved significant task-completion gains in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine designed to give agents persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It supports unified ingestion of multimodal data and offers Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients alongside a local UI.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain builds knowledge graphs using typed edges without requiring LLM calls to generate the structure. It features scoped institutional memory with per-user data isolation and produces cited prose answers with explicit gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while offering connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agent memory learn over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. Its core logic is implemented as a FastAPI server that provides SDKs for managing sessions and peer interactions.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This Elastic License 2.0 provider treats memory as a git repository, utilizing version control actions like commit, branch, and merge for context tree management. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for local storage. It integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI and requires only Python 3.10 and one pure-Python dependency.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context during execution.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and context bundles. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes based on task success.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management through a hierarchical DAG-based engine that ensures no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from its SQLite store.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 22 supported coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over gigabytes of historical data. It allows agents to search months of past sessions while ensuring safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistent state across sessions.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer maintains a living semantic ontology with audit trails linked to raw data sources. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy and provides portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur functions as a shared memory layer that stores data as human-readable YAML files on a local disk. It utilizes a hybrid search mechanism combining BM25 and local embeddings to provide retrieval capabilities for MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, employing a hybrid retrieval system of BM25 and vector search to manage agent memory.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to facilitate prefix reuse. It offers native plugin support for Hermes Agent, reducing prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saving up to 36% of tokens.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. The five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore for durable storage.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and uses a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord or Telegram and includes contradiction tracking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing cross-project memory as inspectable Markdown files. It runs locally without a daemon or telemetry, utilizing DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver specific evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for major coding agent clients, utilizing GGUF models for local processing.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, utilizing a local-first architecture with SQLite and FTS5. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and aims to reduce prompt tokens by up to 94%.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider enables reflective memory through semantic search using BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch alongside BM25 keyword search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer uses Markdown files as a durable source of truth for context across Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It provides a dedicated migration workflow for importing existing chats and project instructions into the agent's environment.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin focuses on data integrity by supporting real, immediate event deletion and providing a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer and serves as a community fix for specific Hermes Agent recall issues.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to enable agents to pay for services or charge for their own API usage with 0% transaction fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations to improve agent routing. It offers tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing implicit and explicit feedback to refine its local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. The system ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for managing state updates and searches.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A operations.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This project provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory of markdown files. It features five slash commands for capturing and recalling information while generating evidence-cited diffs for manual review and JSON output.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to support a structured software development methodology.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables the generation of prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components on macOS and Windows. It features a coding-agent CLI that integrates with Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It enforces architecture contracts through Diagram-as-Test and YAML/JSON rules.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions, payments, and escrow. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes for agents compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that integrates natively with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation directory.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, transcript extraction, and playlist browsing for Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Windsurf. It requires a TranscriptAPI key to access its search and extraction features.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds while providing slash commands for pattern management.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts by generating custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using Pydantic AI to manage modular packages of instructions and resources. It implements progressive disclosure to maintain prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough ideas to structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It features a specialized spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project quality before handoff.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler for extracting runnable source files and automatically synchronizes manual edits back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Written in TypeScript for the Bun runtime, this harness coordinates AI teams using SLP v2 for supervised, role-based work. It manages the entire lifecycle of tasks from open to done through structured command operations without requiring background services.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This collection provides interoperable skills following the Agent Skills specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It enables integration with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, alongside specialized services for CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources specifically in Portuguese. All skills are provided in the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video workflows and supports both Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant instruction files. It links instructions directly to source lines or URLs and includes a full lifecycle for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with support for recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, and incorporates commerce capabilities using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to execute 'Intent as Code' across any model. It audits workflows for costs and permissions before execution and generates verifiable, hash-chained receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided script for validating Nextcloud App Passwords and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for efficiency and offers graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses MCP connections to provide agent-driven scheduling and system design for managing habits and study blocks. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It utilizes a tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of agent capabilities. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI to facilitate tool-based skill loading and automatic directory registration.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation based on real-world CVEs. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and NIST standards.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt. It validates skills against runtime-specific profiles and monitors official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It uses a local Python environment to gate updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages environment-specific path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. it ensures deterministic file operations and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational status.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments upon human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports across multiple geographic scales, from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized utilities for video-to-text transcription, macOS-based OCR for invoices, and an E-commerce Material Studio. It also includes a writing engine designed to adjust the tone and style of AI-generated text.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from providers like OpenAI and DeepSeek. It serves as a reliable source for developers who need current development tools packaged for the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing for mobile agent interaction.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools and persistent memory, allowing the agent to interface with both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on cloud-native state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on security by sandboxing the agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora acts as a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides management features such as per-agent metrics, LLM budget caps, and cost monitoring accessible via REST API, CLI, or MCP.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports hierarchy-aware communication for inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution, specifically supporting recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed knowledge graph of codebases to reduce token consumption and tool calls for coding agents. It features automatic synchronization upon file changes and provides structural extraction for languages including TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI utility tracks token usage across various AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code. Users can monitor their consumption through a 3D visualization dashboard and submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer designed for inspecting API traffic from coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, supporting tools like Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Gemini.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from terminal interfaces. It supports over 35 tools and offers multi-device synchronization alongside historical usage breakdowns by project and model.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project provides custom themes and skins for the Hermes terminal user interface. Users can configure banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration files.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform that enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing users to switch between default and scoped agents seamlessly. It supports project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions to provide agents with specific skills based on the local configuration.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a production-ready stack at zero cost, supporting 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts without using LLMs. It flags vague tool descriptions and missing retry budgets while integrating with GitHub Actions and Hermes Agent verification hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility maps OpenClaw configurations, skills, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to facilitate the transition to Hermes Agent.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue through Hermes Agent. It includes a bounded JSON adapter and requires explicit approval for any external actions or write operations.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A fully local voice assistant for Hermes Agent that supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking with barge-in capabilities. It operates offline without the need for API keys or accounts, utilizing Piper and Kokoro for speech processing.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage for agent memories. It includes tools for adding and deleting memories and features a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a unified desktop interface for controlling Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one desktop controller for multiple agent engines.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and offers remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this project provides a web and mobile-friendly interface for interacting with Hermes Agent. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one location.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard enables unified configuration for Hermes Agent across 10 messaging platforms, including Telegram and Discord. It features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates, local SQLite session storage, and detailed usage analytics for token consumption.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a memory browser, skills manager, and a full workspace file browser equipped with a Monaco editor and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for managing real session data. It includes native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports MCP tools, memory management, and specialized rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments and live browser control with explicit approval gates for all actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone application that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from their mobile device by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables real-time chat, task management, and server file system browsing without subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based monitor features an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a specialized tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and git projects.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser functions as a local cockpit that attributes live quota burn to individual sessions for Codex and Claude. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats without uploading telemetry or session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with terminal chat and file attachment support. It uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication to manage background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that runs without admin rights or system-wide dependencies to provide a Tkinter GUI for local models. It features 100 tools covering music, TTS, and ComfyUI, supported by granular permission controls and session management.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface enables real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes an integrated file browser, a task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for interactive agent control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
